notes.title: Demo 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi, dear appraisers!

Thank you so much for giving the demo a try. We appreciate your feedback and are working on incorporating it into the game.

We have just released an update for the demo fixing a few bugs and inconsistencies.

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed wording here and there and a few typos
[*]Minor quality of life improvements with nested dialogue menus
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug where player could get behind the shopkeeper with no way out
[/list]
Tweaks
[list]
[*]Added some more flavor texts
[*]Added a couple more sound effects to various interactions
[*]Background music will now continue to play in the pause/inventory menu
[*]Tweaked the tree puzzle
[*]Tweaked sound mix and reverb
[*]Screen fades are now slightly shorter
[/list]

notes.title: A sneak preview!
notes.content:
Hey there folks! 

We've been posting daily gifs over on our [url=https://twitter.com/PlayFeyGame]Twitter[/url].

Today we'll give you an update on the game by speaking about three in particular. 

[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.vgy.me/wYWro4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]FISHING IS CONFIRMED[/b][/h3]
For real, would it even be a real video game without a fishing minigame? I hope you'll enjoy trying to catch a fish (or whatever else falls for the bait) when the game releases.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41345351/f216106382e5a36393d0afa8594b8d9f77b0ed41.gif[/img]

[h3][b]RUBBER DUCKS CONFIRMED[/b][/h3]
Yeah, you heard right! There's rubber ducks in this game. While we can't promise you'll be able to take a bath yourself, their presence will be felt. We promise. 

[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.vgy.me/W2Cumx.gif[/img]

[h3][b]BOOKS ARE BACK[/b][/h3]
Yes, we are not kidding. Nowadays, we're all on our phone are reading steam posts on our computers but we're all about nostalgia and, let's be real, [i]what's more nostalgic than books[/i]? 
Huh? VHS you say? Okay, fair point. We might add those too...

[hr][/hr]
That's all we got for today, but worry not, we'll be back! Please give us a follow on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayFeyGame]Twitter[/url] and tell all your friends to follow and wishlist the game, we're not kidding!
